# Dedication {.unnumbered .unlisted .oculto}

::: {.dedicatoria}
**In memory of Iñaqui Ulibarri García de la Cueva**

The teacher who gave us our wings and taught us to fly wisely.

We still feel you in the back seat; you are with us in every thermal and in every decision we take in command, remembering your lessons.

Thank you for leaving us your immense passion, the finest of legacies.
:::
